text:
Predicates:
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
ContainsKnowledge(x) ::: x contains tons of knowledge.
Reads(x, y) ::: person x reads book y.
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: person x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: person x becomes smarter.
Premises:
∀x (Book(x) → ContainsKnowledge(x)) ::: Books contain tons of knowledge.
∀x ∀y ((Reads(x, y) ∧ Book(y)) → GainsKnowledge(x)) ::: When a person reads a book, that person gains knowledge.
∀x (GainsKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x)) ::: If a person gains knowledge, they become smarter.
Reads(harry, walden) ::: Harry read the book 'Walden' by Henry Thoreau.
Conclusion:
∀x (Smarter(x) → GainsKnowledge(x)) ::: A smarter person has gained knowledge.
